author: claude-opus-5-5
comparison: Rejected drawing had an 8-high desktop slab and an 8-high post/seat box whose counters pinched shut at 48, and the seat read as a drawer frame; the original has a thick desktop, a seat overhanging its posts and splayed legs.
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px light/dark. Chair back arch over a thick rounded desktop, posts to an overhanging seat and splayed legs, desk legs at the ends; reads as the reference.
omissions: The seat's cushion outline (a closed pill needs 10 units of height).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'armchair' legs and rounded slab corners.
